goal: Port OctoLogin-style auth endpoint selection into the native Windows headless portal worker: shared last-good cache, OctoWoW play/normal DNS candidates, bounded challenge probes and reconnect failover without loading WoW DLLs.
notes: Windows-only by default (WOW112_AUTH_SELECTOR can override). The selector caches a fully authenticated last-good SocketAddr for 180s beside the shared worker binary, so normal fleet reconnects do not fan out. On failure it probes a bounded maximum of 8 endpoints using only a WoW logon challenge with a nonexistent account, then performs the real SRP login on the selected endpoint. Existing mail mutation hard-stop semantics are untouched.
